inputs.prompt: A cinematic film still, a medium close-up at eye level, of a Black British woman in her late thirties in a bright, modern open-plan office in the daytime. She has dark natural hair pulled back, small gold earrings and a soft mustard-yellow knit jumper. She stands beside her desk and holds a slim smartphone in one hand at chest height, with the plain dark back of the phone toward the camera. She has just read something on it: her head is tilted a little down toward the phone, her face still fully visible, with her eyebrows lifting and the first hint of a pleasantly surprised smile, lips closed. Her body is turned three-quarters to the left of the camera. Behind her, softly out of focus: big windows full of clean daylight, pale desks, green plants and one or two colleagues far away. Fresh, bright, airy daylight with a slightly cool white balance. 50mm lens at f/2, shallow depth of field, natural skin texture and a true-to-life deep-brown skin tone, no beauty retouching: an ordinary, likeable working person, not a model. Photorealistic, like a frame from a premium advertising film shot on a cinema camera. Nothing written anywhere: no logos, no signs, no labels, no readable text on any object or screen. Every monitor faces away from the camera.

expect.unit: USD (the endpoint bills in units of 1 dollar, by tokens)
expect.basis: WP1 paid 6 to 8.5 cents for a 2K picture on this model (demo-video/ledger/wp1.csv)

note: hook-1: the colleague in the bright office by day, reading her phone (first frame of the shot)
